review_candidates.title: Product Manager
review_candidates.description: CapsLock builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships. Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally. Role Overview We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on. Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product. This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations. Responsibilities 1. Product Strategy & Roadmap Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration. Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform. User Needs & Automation Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows. Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged. Product Development & Delivery Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion. Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable. Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs. Experimentation & Optimization Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets. Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs. Requirements: 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end. review_candidates.description: Partnership Development Manager Department: BisDevTech, MarTech and Partnerships Work Format: Full-time | Remote / International Language: English Level: Senior About the Role Deep Knowledge Group ( www.dkv.global ) is seeking a Partnership Development Manager to build scalable commercial and strategic distribution around DKG's portfolio . This role is intentionally distinct from conventional Business Development. A Business Development Manager primarily asks: Who can buy this product? The Partnership Development Manager must also ask: Who can distribute it, implement it, co-develop it, open a market for it, add a missing capability, bring customers to it, or create a much larger commercial opportunity together with DKG? DKG's project portfolio creates multiple partnership models: regional representatives, distributors and resellers; strategic institutional partners; technology and data providers; vendors; media and event partners; corporate partners; white-label collaborators; joint-development and JV candidates; ambassadors; and commercial intermediaries with existing market access. The objective of this role is to convert those models into functioning partnerships with measurable activity. Core Mandate Build a partner network that gives DKG commercial leverage beyond what its internal team could achieve alone . This means identifying the right partner type for each product, approaching the strongest candidates, creating a compelling structure for cooperation, onboarding them properly and ensuring that partnerships become active rather than remaining signed documents. Key Responsibilities Map the partner ecosystem around priority DKG products and markets. Determine the appropriate partnership model for different product families. Identify and qualify potential distributors, resellers, regional representatives, JV partners, implementation partners, vendors, strategic institutions, media partners and co-development counterparties. Develop partnership propositions tailored to the specific economics and interests of each counterparty. Conduct outreach and partnership negotiations. Structure agreements together with DKG management and Legal. Build commission, revenue-share, referral, co-development, licensing and other partnership models where appropriate. Onboard regional and commercial representatives and ensure they receive suitable product materials, scripts and access to Data Rooms. Equip partners with enough DKG and product fluency to represent the Group credibly. Track partner-generated opportunities, introductions, pipeline and commercial outcomes. Identify inactive partnerships early and either reactivate or discontinue them. Coordinate with Business Development where a partner creates direct customer opportunities. Coordinate with Product Development when a partner can add technical, distribution or market capability. Gather structured feedback from external partners on product-market fit and commercial barriers. Use and improve DKG's PartnershipTech / partnership-management infrastructure as an operational tool, rather than allowing platform development to delay active partnership work. Partnership Models You May Work With Depending on the product, these may include: regional representatives and independent commercial operators; distributors and resellers; white-label partners; co-development partners; strategic corporate and institutional partnerships; government and ecosystem collaborators; media and conference partnerships; technology and data providers; clinics, HealthTech companies and other Longevity ecosystem partners; marketplace vendors; referral and affiliate models; JVs and regional commercialization structures; ambassadors and industry connectors. Requirements 4+ years in strategic partnerships, channel development, alliances, B2B business development or related work. Demonstrated record of creating partnerships that generated measurable activity, customers, distribution or revenue. Strong ability to identify mutual commercial value rather than proposing generic “strategic cooperation.” Strong relationship-development and negotiation skills. Experience managing external counterparties after agreement, not only reaching signature. Ability to understand sophisticated technology and commercial products quickly. Strong written communication and proposal-development ability. Experience with CRM, partner pipelines or comparable structured relationship-management systems. High degree of autonomy and follow-through. Strong practical use of AI for research, counterparty analysis and communication preparation. Excellent English. Strong Advantages Experience with channel sales, affiliate or ambassador networks, licensing, white-label arrangements or JVs. Existing network across technology, investment, healthcare, FinTech, innovation ecosystems or regional business-development communities. Experience building international or regional partner networks. Experience working with platform or marketplace businesses. GCC/UAE or Asian market experience.
